beaches.name: Obelisk Beach
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is permitted across Obelisk Beach. Mosman Council lists Obelisk and Cobblers as nude bathing areas in Sydney Harbour National Park, and Obelisk Beach is a designated beach under s.633 of the NSW Local Government Act 1993, so council notices cannot prohibit nudity there.

beaches.name: Cobblers Beach
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is permitted across Cobblers Beach. NSW National Parks describes it as a designated nude bathing area in Sydney Harbour National Park, and Mosman Council lists Cobblers and Obelisk as nude bathing areas. Clothing is required in the surrounding bushland and on the grassed area directly behind the beach.
